主要内容: On January 3, 2013, Broadway Financial Corporation was notified by NASDAQ that its common stock failed to maintain a minimum bid price of $1.00 over the previous 30 consecutive business days. However, as of September 16, 2013, the company's common stock had met the minimum bid price requirement for the last 10 consecutive business days, from August 30, 2013, to September 13, 2013. On September 16, 2013, the company received confirmation from NASDAQ that it had regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), and the matter was closed.
